homepageTopArticles.title: Richemont Sales Climb 16% in H1 With All Regions, Except for the Middle East, Showing Robust Growth
homepageTopArticles.snippet: At constant exchange rates, Richemont sales were up 17 percent to 12.3 billion euros with all regions, except for the Middle East, growing in the double-digits.

homepageTopArticles.title: Amazon's plan to own the world's product data and fight AI shopping agents
homepageTopArticles.snippet: Called World Product Graph, the initiative seeks to hoover up data on virtually every item for sale on Earth, whether Amazon stocks it or not, according to an internal document reviewed by Reuters, and to people familiar with the matter.
